Ready, Viktor?

🌀 NEW! Wormholes link the upper-left and lower-right corners. Drive into one at any size! Find purple and cyan rings on your minimap.

Your truck is hungry! Drive into little cars to grow. Then gobble picnic tables, swing sets, swimming pools, and whole buildings!

Watch out for snails! They go POP, fart, and shrink your truck. One chupacabra roams the map. Eat it at MEGA size, and another appears 30 seconds later!

✨ Catch golden cars for extra growth! Keep munching for streak bonuses, and find silly surprises inside houses.

🚀 Find Saturn Space Park, with its pond and trees! Drive through the water to splash. Visit the launch pad at MEGA size for MUSK MODE! Your truck shrinks and flies across the map to another neighborhood, then lands at full MEGA size. A new rocket arrives three minutes later.

☢ Bomb chase: the first starts after 3 minutes of play, then every 3, 5, or 7 minutes at random. Follow the red map marker and eat the bomb-carrying Chupacabra within 10 seconds at ANY size for +1,000 bonus points! If time runs out, the city explodes. Restart rebuilds the city.

🚧 At MEGA size, collect 10 cats to unlock 10 seconds as a yellow dozer! Push the city into piles without munching it.
